product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker is an asset lifecycle management platform that helps owners and operators of critical infrastructure plan, build, operate, and maintain projects and assets.
product_one_liner.notes: The official homepage describes Sitetracker as Asset Lifecycle Management software for asset owners and operators, covering planning and development, construction, operations and maintenance, and asset management.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage directs visitors to a live demo rather than a public pricing page; the pricing-site inventory reports no pricing URL/page in the company sitemap and says the commercial path is a demo request. A downloadable Scout pricing-terms appendix is not a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official homepage logo wall explicitly labels Ericsson and Vodafone as customer logos. | named_customers.0: The official homepage labels Ericsson as a customer logo. | named_customers.1: The official homepage labels Vodafone as a customer logo.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile lists its size as 201–500 employees, matching the allowed band exactly.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s LinkedIn profile gives its headquarters as Montclair, New Jersey; the city value is Montclair. | hq_country: Sitetracker’s privacy policy describes the company as U.S.-headquartered, establishing the country as the United States.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index and its next page list industry guides, product/AI thought leadership, customer stories, and operational advice. The index does not show multiple engineer-authored posts about how the product is built, so it does not meet the engineering-blog criterion.

public_docs.notes: Sitetracker’s product documentation and integration materials are described as residing in its Salesforce Community, whose observed page is a Salesforce login; the API/developer documentation profile likewise reports no public developer portal and says documentation is behind that login. The public homepage does not link to a public product-docs portal. The publicly accessible EDU support FAQ is for course access, not product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Lever listing is titled Senior Software Engineer II – AI, is in R&D/Scout Engineering, and includes an apply link; this is an open AI role.

model_provider.notes: The Scout engineering job posting describes building customer-facing LLM features over frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI. The product video separately says users can choose their preferred LLM or Scout’s auto-selected model, without naming the auto-selected provider; the named providers are therefore supported by the engineering posting.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official Trust Center identifies a 2026 SOC 2 Type II report and the Sitetracker ISO 27001:2022 certification; these are the requested certifications named there. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center labels the report SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center labels Sitetracker ISO 27001:2022 Certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The official financing release names the Series D financing, while the funding profile identifies that Series D as the latest round. The stage is Series D. | funding_date: The official financing announcement is dated September 28, 2022 and describes completion of the Series D financing package, giving the YYYY-MM date 2022-09. | funding_amount_usd: Sitetracker’s official financing announcement says its completed equity-and-debt financing totaled $96M, comprising $66M in equity and a $30M revolving credit facility; the reported package amount is $96,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile identifies the Series D in October 2022 as the latest round, and the company’s official release describes the 2022 financing. Both dates precede the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025, so no funding in the requested window is evidenced.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Lever listing is for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) and includes an apply link.

launched_6mo.notes: Sitetracker’s September 23, 2026 announcement says it and 5×5 Technologies introduced a new data-to-twin workflow, a major feature launch inside the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kimberly Caldwell’s profile lists a Vice President role at Sitetracker beginning February 1, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Sitetracker’s integrations page says its platform is built natively on Salesforce and lists Salesforce among its live integrations. A Sitetracker sales-and-marketing customer story says the team uses DocSend for finalized sales collateral. | crm_stack_signal.0: The integrations page says the platform is built natively on Salesforce and lists Salesforce among its live integrations. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Sitetracker sales-and-marketing case study states that DocSend is used for finalized sales collateral.
